_comment: Five standalone films, cut from the same four screen recordings as the 90-second explainer but with their own narration. Every in/out point below was read off frame strips of the source, not guessed - see README. Scene LENGTH is never set here: each scene runs exactly as long as its narration, so re-writing a line re-times the picture automatically.

scenes.vo: Set up your profile once. Every application after this uses it.
Open the menu, then Account Settings.
scenes.head: Menu, then Account Settings
scenes.sub: Everything about you lives here

scenes.vo: Add your details. Name, phone, address, date of birth.
scenes.head: Your details
scenes.sub: Typed once, kept for every form

scenes.vo: Attach your résumé.
scenes.head: Attach your résumé
scenes.sub: PDF or Word, straight from your phone

scenes.vo: That is the file it attaches for you later.
scenes.head: Uploaded
scenes.sub: This is the file it will attach for you

scenes.vo: No signature? It draws one from your name. Pick a style.
scenes.head: A signature from your name
scenes.sub: Or upload your own

scenes.vo: Save. Done. You will not type any of this again.
scenes.head: Saved
scenes.sub: You won’t be asked for this again

scenes.vo: Next. Generate your résumé with AI.
Generate your résumé with AI, formatted for where you apply.

card.sub: And formatted for where you apply

scenes.vo: Before a human reads your résumé, software does. Pretty templates fail it. So every format here is rated. Five stars reads perfectly.
scenes.note: The star rating is the app's own ATS rating (server/utils/resumeTemplates.js), shown on the picker. No percentile or success-rate claim.

scenes.vo: Open Resume Builder.
scenes.head: Tell it your story
scenes.sub: Rough notes are enough

scenes.vo: Paste anything. An old résumé, a LinkedIn bio, rough notes.

scenes.vo: Generate. A structured résumé comes back.
scenes.head: Structured, not just tidied
scenes.sub: Summary · experience · skills

scenes.vo: A German CV needs a photo. A US résumé must not have one. Pick your region, and it rebuilds instantly.
Swipe the formats. Each one shows its star rating.

Search inside the app. Describe the job you want.
